ruleLine: capture one OR three table cards of a rank / when you cannot, your whole hand joins the table and you are out
takeThreeHint: three of that rank are on the table
landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
hint.take_one: this captures a table card of the same rank
hint.take_three: three of that rank are on the table, so take them all
hint.must_lie_down: nothing matches, so your hand goes to the table and you are out
tutorial.table: All twelve table cards are face up from the start -- there is no face-down stock. You capture while watching how many of each rank remain.
tutorial.capture: Play one card from hand to capture table cards of the same rank. You take one or three; never two, never four.
tutorial.liedown: When nothing in your hand matches, your whole hand goes to the table and you are out. Those cards become everyone else's prey, so this is more than elimination.
tutorial.settle: You settle on captured cards against eight, and whoever was last in takes 5 from the pot.
